fib: ______ is a financial account between a bank customer and a financial institution.
bank account
A bank account is a financial account between a bank customer and a financial institution.
______ is a general lien, which confers a right to retain properties in respect of any general balance due by the debtor to the banker.
banker's lien
A banker's lien is a general lien, which confers a right to retain properties in respect of any general balance due by the debtor to the banker.
______ is the party to whom the property is delivered.
Bailee
Bailee is the party to whom the property is delivered.
______ may be defined as a transfer, by way of security of the general ownership of the chattel, subject to the equity of redemption of the mortgagor.
'mortgage of movables
A 'mortgage of movables' may be defined as a transfer, by way of security of the general ownership of the chattel, subject to the equity of redemption of the mortgagor.
______ is a document issued by a warehouse-keeper containing the same statement.
warehouse warrant
A warehouse warrant is a document issued by a warehouse-keeper containing the same statement.
______ is the same as "I promise to pay you on demand" and if the latter words do not have the effect of restricting negotiability, the former cannot have that effect.
implication these words
The implication these words is the same as "I promise to pay you on demand" and if the latter words do not have the effect of restricting negotiability, the former cannot have that effect.
______ are used primarily in international trade, and are written orders by one person to his bank to pay the bearer a specific sum on a specific date.
Bills of exchange
Bills of exchange are used primarily in international trade, and are written orders by one person to his bank to pay the bearer a specific sum on a specific date.
______ is a contract for delivering goods by one party to another to be held in trust for a specific period and returned when the purpose is ended. ii.
Bailment
Bailment is a contract for delivering goods by one party to another to be held in trust for a specific period and returned when the purpose is ended. ii.
______ are regarded in law as together making up the 'owner.' Any action against them (pertaining to that account) is made against jointly and not individually (severally).
Joint holders of an account
Joint holders of an account are regarded in law as together making up the 'owner.' Any action against them (pertaining to that account) is made against jointly and not individually (severally).
______ is the bank which negotiates the bills or drafts under the letter of credit.
negotiating bank
v) The negotiating bank is the bank which negotiates the bills or drafts under the letter of credit.
______ is an order addressed to the warehouse keeper where the goods are stored to deliver the goods mentioned therein to a particular person.
'delivery order
The 'delivery order' is an order addressed to the warehouse keeper where the goods are stored to deliver the goods mentioned therein to a particular person.
______ is a contract by which one party promises to save the other from loss caused to him by the conduct of either the promisor himself, or by the conduct of any other person.
contract of indemnity
A contract of indemnity is a contract by which one party promises to save the other from loss caused to him by the conduct of either the promisor himself, or by the conduct of any other person.
______ is the property that is pledged by a loan beneficiary towards securing the facility.
Collateral security
Collateral security is the property that is pledged by a loan beneficiary towards securing the facility.
______ means an amount that can be determined in relation to the face value of the instrument.
Fixed amount for payment
Fixed amount for payment means an amount that can be determined in relation to the face value of the instrument.
